What this means for your business

The tool does not create quality by itself. The plan, build, hosting, updates, accessibility, content, connections, handoff, and ongoing care decide whether the site stays useful.

What to watch

  • A tool recommendation made before anyone lists what the site must do.
  • Add-ons or apps with no owner or update plan.
  • A custom site with no project files, instructions, or recovery path.
  • An editing screen the real staff cannot use.

Do this next

  1. List the pages, repeated information, customer actions, tool connections, and people who will make updates.
  2. Name who owns updates, hosting, accounts, project files, and support.
  3. Build one real example page before committing.
  4. Price launch, care, moving away, and handoff together.

When Little Fight fits

We choose the tool that fits the business and hand over the project files, accounts, data, and instructions. Custom is an option, not a personality test.

Get a plain-English second opinion

Sources and further reading

Product features and rules can change. Use the linked source as the current word.

  • WordPress features — Official open-source software feature source.
  • Webflow: Choose a Site plan — Official hosting, CMS, custom-code, and plan guidance.

insight.answer: WordPress has many add-ons, Webflow is a hosted visual builder, and custom code gives you control over exactly what is built. The best choice is the one your business can own and keep working.
